releaseApproval.reviewer: Release gate review following the user-authorized v2.0.0 publication request; format contracts checked against the unchanged matrix
evidence: This release changes the browser desktop shell and navigation UI. Encrypted object, key derivation, AAD, directory, trash, manifest, backup, SQLite, and client mutation contracts remain unchanged from v1.3.7.
Local make test passed with Go 1.27.1, Node 26.0.0, and pnpm 11.24.0, including frontend typecheck/lint/build, Go tests, installer/update tests, 533 web tests, and 3 TLS proxy tests.
Local go test -race -count=1 ./... passed on macOS arm64.

Publication remains gated on successful exact-commit main CI on Ubuntu 24.04, including all-package race checks and Linux amd64/arm64 cross-builds; the release workflow builds and checksum-publishes both architectures.
Manual browser screenshot and mobile-device visual QA were not performed and are not claimed as verified.

scope: XDrive v2.0.0 desktop shell and settings UI redesign; persistent data, cryptographic, SQLite, backup, and client mutation contracts unchanged from v1.3.7

meaning.1: legacy direct Vault Key file and thumbnail derivation
meaning.2: K_data hierarchy for newly encrypted files and thumbnails

localState.plaintextPolicy: encrypted with K_local before IndexedDB persistence

sqlite.migrationPolicy: forward only; after a schema-changing migration, restore the matching pre-migration database and binary before rollback

clientMutationProtocol.acceptance: exact match only; reject missing, older, and future versions before reading mutation bodies

evolutionPolicy: Unknown payload versions and unknown fields remain fail-closed.
The listed optional fields and their absent-value meanings are part of the current schema contract.
Adding or redefining a payload field requires a new payload schema version; it must not silently expand an older strict reader.
A change that makes a stale client unsafe for mutations increments the client mutation protocol version in Go and TypeScript.
Key derivation or AAD meaning changes use their own crypto version; they do not reuse a payload schema number.
SQLite schema migration, backup container format, encrypted object envelope, and browser payload schema are independent version dimensions.
